headline: **MLB Daily Roundup: August 11, 2026**
article:
The Washington Nationals secured a convincing 7-1 victory over the Cincinnati Reds, with Abimelec Ortiz leading the Reds' offense with 2 hits, including a home run, and 1 RBI. Brad Lord pitched 2.2 strong innings for the Reds, striking out 4 batters and allowing 1 earned run.

Several key players have been impacted by injuries, including Tyler Freeman of the Colorado Rockies, who has been placed on the 10-day injured list due to lumbar pain. Other injured players include Nathan Eovaldi of the Texas Rangers, Shaun Anderson of the Los Angeles Angels, Devin Williams of the New York Mets, Caleb Kilian of the Philadelphia Phillies, Griffin Jax of the Tampa Bay Rays, Cooper Pratt of the Milwaukee Brewers, and Jack Leiter of the Texas Rangers.

The Kansas City Royals made a significant trade, acquiring first baseman Jacob Berry from the Miami Marlins. The Athletics also made a trade, acquiring right-handed pitcher Seth Johnson from the Philadelphia Phillies in exchange for right fielder Colby Thomas. The Miami Marlins traded right-handed pitcher Lake Bachar to the Pittsburgh Pirates for right-handed pitcher Brandan Bidois, left fielder Brian Sanchez, and infielder Hyun Seung Lee. The Colorado Rockies traded right-handed pitcher Victor Vodnik to the Miami Marlins for first baseman Connor Norby and right-handed pitcher Aiden May.

top_news.title: **Reds Fall to Nationals in Dominant 7-1 Loss**
top_news.summary: The Washington Nationals secured a convincing 7-1 victory over the Cincinnati Reds, with Abimelec Ortiz leading the Reds' offense with 2 hits, including a home run, and 1 RBI. Brad Lord pitched 2.2 strong innings for the Reds, striking out 4 batters and allowing 1 earned run.

top_news.title: **Athletics Edge Red Sox in Thrilling 4-3 Victory**
top_news.summary: The Oakland Athletics secured a narrow win over the Boston Red Sox, finishing the game 4-3. Eli White led the Athletics' offense with a 3-hit performance.

top_news.title: **Mets Cruise Past Pirates 11-1**
top_news.summary: The New York Mets dominated the Pittsburgh Pirates, securing an 11-1 victory. Sean Manaea led the way on the mound, pitching 7.0 innings with 11 strikeouts and just 1 earned run.

top_news.title: **Phillies Edge Blue Jays in Thrilling Finish**
top_news.summary: The Philadelphia Phillies secured a 7-6 victory over the Toronto Blue Jays, with Caleb Kilian earning the win. Kyle Schwarber led the Phillies' offense with two home runs and four RBIs.

top_news.title: **Rockies Place Tyler Freeman on Injured List**
top_news.summary: Colorado Rockies right fielder Tyler Freeman has been placed on the 10-day injured list due to lumbar pain, effective retroactive to August 9, 2026.

top_news.title: **Berry Joins Royals in Trade**
top_news.summary: The Kansas City Royals acquired first baseman Jacob Berry from the Miami Marlins on August 5, 2026. Berry is now a member of the Kansas City Royals.
